name: @vibecook/mille-truffle
description: Serve a mille workspace to another tailnet device over Truffle.
//peerDependencies: `workspace:^` publishes as `^x.y.z`; `workspace:*` would emit the exact `x.y.z`. This package reaches into mille's `./host`, `./client` and `./node` subpaths, so it tracks the minor line it was built against — but pinning a peer to one patch would make every mille patch release an unsatisfiable peer for anyone holding this one.
